name: media_library_operations
description: Operational idempotency receipt for folder creation and atomic copy/move commands, scoped to a company, acting membership and normalized request hash. Authoritative business events remain in media_audit_events.
lifecycle: Inserted with the command result in the same transaction as its changes. Immutable during a 30-day replay window. Maintenance deletes up to 1000 expired receipts per pass; repeating an expired operation ID is a new command.

columns.Meaning: Company owning the command and result; part of the receipt key.
Caller-generated UUID for one command intent, reused for safe replay within the retention window.
Membership that submitted the command; another membership cannot replay it.
SHA-256 of the normalized command and operation category, compared to refuse key reuse with different intent. Never exposed.
Bounded result containing root item IDs/kinds and affected-item count, with no file content, names, paths or credentials.
PostgreSQL-clock receipt creation instant; controls the replay retention window.

constraints.Physical definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id, actor_membership_id) REFERENCES memberships(company_id, id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
constraints.Purpose: The submitting membership belongs to the same company.

constraints.Physical definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id) REFERENCES companies(id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
constraints.Purpose: The command belongs to an existing company.
Request hashes are full SHA-256 digests.
One receipt per command UUID within a company.
Stored command results are JSON objects.

constraints.Physical definition: CREATE INDEX media_library_operations_created_idx ON public.media_library_operations USING btree (created_at)
constraints.Purpose: Finds expired operational receipts without scanning live results.
